SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts 
WHERE 
  start_date = DATE('2026-06-01') 
  AND end_date = DATE('2026-06-08')

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS successful_transactions
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions
WHERE 
  start_date = DATE('2026-06-01') AND 
  end_date = DATE('2026-06-07') AND 
  is_success = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions 
WHERE 
  start_date = DATE('2026-06-01') 
  AND end_date = DATE('2026-06-08') 
  AND is_success = FALSE

SELECT 
  SUM(value_wei) AS total_wei_value
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts
WHERE 
  start_date = DATE('2026-06-01') AND end_date = DATE('2026-06-07')

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.block_facts 
WHERE start_date = DATE('2026-06-01') AND end_date = DATE('2026-06-07')

SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count
FROM nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.block_facts
WHERE start_date = DATE('2026-06-01') AND end_date = DATE('2026-06-07')

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers 
WHERE 
  start_date = DATE('2026-06-01') 
  AND end_date = DATE('2026-06-08')

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS token_transfer_count
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers
WHERE 
  start_date = DATE('2026-06-01') AND end_date = DATE('2026-06-08')
  AND value_cast_valid = TRUE
  AND normalized_amount > 0

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions

  start_date = '2026-06-22' 
  AND end_date = '2026-06-30'

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS successful_transactions
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions
WHERE 
  start_date = DATE('2026-06-22') 
  AND end_date = DATE('2026-06-30') 
  AND is_success = TRUE
